code.description: Primary agent for writing, editing, and running code across any language

research.description: Explores and analyzes the codebase to find patterns, files, and architecture

debug.description: Diagnoses and fixes errors, runs diagnostics and troubleshooting

refactor.description: Cleans up, optimizes, and restructures code for better quality

document.description: Creates and maintains documentation without modifying source code

analyze.description: Analyze project structure and provide a summary
analyze.template:
Analyze this project: language, framework, directory structure, dependencies, architecture. Current state:
!`ls -la`
!`git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null || echo "no git history"`
Provide a concise summary.

fix.description: Find and fix issues in the codebase
fix.template:
Scan the codebase for bugs and errors.
!`git status --short`
!`git diff --stat`
List findings with severity, then fix critical ones.

explain.description: Explain a specific file, function, or concept
explain.template: Explain $ARGUMENTS. Break down: purpose, how it works, key patterns, dependencies, edge cases.
